objective: Determine whether explicitly authorized bounded recovery during planner wait improves useful-control continuity versus unauthored coast under matched MAP01 conditions without weakening freshness, release, scorer isolation, launch ownership, or terminal-score correctness.

supersedes_construction.reason: v1 predates the duplicated live-02 allocation correction, strict terminal-score agreement audit, and one-shot launch-owner guard

decision_rule.PASS: All hard and exposure gates pass; bounded recovery has a strictly lower no-retained-input upper bound in at least one matched planner-wait interval; and independent outcome evidence is directionally useful: either an earlier positive independent progress event or a strictly better matched terminal score occurs without an earlier matched negative event.
decision_rule.HOLD_MECHANISM_ONLY: Safety and exposure gates pass and recovery reduces no-retained-input time, but no independent useful-effect or terminal-score advantage is observed. Retain the continuity result but do not call it useful-control efficacy.
decision_rule.FAIL: Any hard gate fails; recovery admits stale authority; release is unverifiable; a non-owner or duplicate formal launch enters the formal step; terminal score disagrees with the final independent scorer; or recovery produces an earlier matched negative event without an earlier positive event.
decision_rule.UNCERTAIN: Clock mapping or interval width prevents direction, the recovery path is not exposed before planner completion, or the matched pair does not provide interpretable independent outcome evidence.
decision_rule.HOLD: The allocation is valid and safe but evidence is too sparse for promotion; preserve the first outcome and redesign only under a new versioned allocation.

product_hunt_claim_boundary.allowed_only_if_PASS: In this matched MAP01 allocation, explicitly bounded local recovery reduced planner-wait idle control and produced independent useful outcome evidence while preserving stale-input refusal and verified release.
product_hunt_claim_boundary.allowed_if_HOLD_MECHANISM_ONLY: In this matched MAP01 allocation, bounded local recovery reduced measured no-input planner-wait while preserving the frozen safety gates; useful task benefit was not established.
